input.standard: ASTM E741 (concentration decay, single zone); ASTM D6245 (occupant CO2 as tracer)
input.purpose: Measure V_lab, the volume of air served by scrubber-1-v8 in /habitat/lab, as V = Qe * tau from the CO2 curve, occupant as source.

steps.why: Reduced speed (the floor, never stopped): lowers the effective flow to 0.3 m3/min so CO2 moves towards a higher equilibrium than at full speed; the first ~10 min (3 lags of 3.33 min) are transient and excluded from the fit. Hatch-1-v8 closed.
Full speed (Qe = 1 m3/min): record the decay towards its equilibrium, about one tau for a first guess V = 30 m3 (tau = 30 min), fitted C(t) = Ceq + (C0 - Ceq) exp(-t/tau). Hatch unchanged, closed.

abort.when: CO2 of the Lab at or above 3200 ppm
the device refuses a step's command
battery state of charge under 35 percent
FE-1 out of the 45-120 bpm band, monitoring lost, or one more person enters the Lab

monitoring.reason: FE-1 is the only occupant of the Lab, the volume whose CO2 the test raises; the hab-b occupants are in another volume with the hatch closed.

expected.rise: At 30 percent the effective flow is 0.3 m3/min; for one awake occupant (0.38 L/min) the equilibrium is about 1270 ppm above scrubbed air for V = 30 m3, so from 1900 ppm the CO2 may rise only slowly or even fall, depending on hab-b exchange; any rise is expected to stay under 3000 ppm. If CO2 does not move by several hundred ppm, the rise is weak and tau is taken from step 2 only.
expected.decay: After returning to 100 percent the CO2 falls exponentially towards a lower equilibrium with tau = V/Qe; for a first guess V = 30 m3, tau is about 30 min (lag 3.33 min on top). V_lab = 1 m3/min * tau, expected in the 10 to 200 m3 range, near 30 m3.
expected.refutation: Hypotheses fail if the fit residual is not white or tau differs between steps by a large factor, if the hab-b CO2 (co2-2) moves in step with the Lab (exchange through the closed hatch), if a person enters or leaves, or if the device refuses or does not follow the commanded speed.
expected.fit: Exclude the first 10 min after each speed change (scrubber lag 3.33 min); record the Lab CO2 every minute, the speed commands and their acceptance, and the hab-b CO2.

hypotheses: Lab is one well-mixed zone (sensor co2-1-v8 is representative).

Hatch-1-v8 is held closed during the whole test; the exchange through the closed hatch (design ventilation 3 m3/min per station-topology) is NOT measured and is not assumed zero: hab-b CO2 is recorded to show it.
The single occupant FE-1 stays in the Lab at constant awake activity (0.38 L/min, band 0.26 to 0.45); the source is not measured.
Qe = 1 m3/min at full speed and proportional to speed, per the datasheet; the scrubber lag is 3.33 min.

The first volume guess of 30 m3 only sizes the durations; the phases (20 min at tau about 100 min at 30 percent, 35 min) are shorter than one time constant at reduced speed because the 60 min ceiling binds, so the fit relies mostly on step 2 and on the asymptote being fitted.
Sensor noise and calibration of co2-1-v8 are assumed small against a change of several hundred ppm.
